title: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.02193v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. translated_title: 分层连续扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 离散扩散语言模型为需要双向推理和全局约束满足的任务提供了一种极具吸引力的自回归生成替代方案。然而，它们存在一个共同的结构性瓶颈：在并行解码时，每个词元都是从其边缘分布中独立采样的，切断了同时解码的词元之间的统计依赖关系。连续扩散语言模型通过对共享的连续状态进行去噪来避免这一问题，但其去噪器只能看到该连续状态，因此在最终解码之前，没有任何机制将其与有效的词元配置关联起来。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM），它在单一的、有原则的去噪过程中将离散词元生成与连续潜在轨迹耦合在一起，其训练目标由词元似然的变分界推导而来。与近期将连续上下文附加到自包含方法上的做法不同……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出分层连续扩散语言模型HC-DLM，在单一去噪过程中将离散词元生成与连续潜在轨迹耦合，训练目标源自词元似然的变分界，同时克服了离散扩散模型并行解码时独立性采样瓶颈以及连续扩散模型与有效词元配置脱节的问题。
en_tdlr: HC-DLM couples discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory within a single principled denoising process, trained via a variational bound on token likelihood, addressing both the independent-sampling bottleneck of discrete diffusion and the disconnection from valid token configurations in continuous diffusion.
